serviceIdentification.serviceName: Canon Office Cloud – Managed Print Services
serviceIdentification.serviceAcronym: Canon Office Cloud – Managed Print Services
serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Canon Office Cloud is a managed print platform offering two services to help federal agencies manage their print environment.

Output and Scan Management Service: designed to help provide access control to documents, reduce overall printing costs, and improve office productivity.  

Key features include:
·        CAC/PIV/SIPR authentication to compatible Canon imageRUNNER ADVANCE devices 
·        Secure Print feature provides document access control
·        Delegated printing
·        Document scanning to FedRAMP¬ authorized cloud services such as: Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, Google Drive, Exchange, and BOX
·        Tracking and reporting of print, scan, and copy costs

Fleet Auditing and Management Service:  offers advanced auditing and fleet management capabilities.  
Device-agnostic discovery enables users to track asset inventories, device use, automatic supply replenishment, and fleet health.

Key features include:
•        Centralized usage reporting 
•        Print device status and alerting 
•        Customizable toner replenishment 
•        Automated meter collection tools 
•        Service-alert notifications 
•        Inventory change tracking 
•        Service-performance analysis 
•        Robust fleet analysis and reporting 
•        Device security audit and alerting 
•        ServiceNow integration (optional)
